title: rape-sentencing-guideline.pdf — section 9
text:
18. The following table contains a non-exhaustive list of possible aggravating factors which may
apply to the offence and the offender. The court should consider which, if any, of these factors
apply, together with any other aggravating or mitigating factors.

19. Regard should also be had to annexes A, B, and C to the Council’s guideline ‘The sentencing
process’, which include further examples of aggravating and mitigating factors.

20. In some cases the consideration of aggravating and mitigating factors may move the headline
sentence outside the range selected at step 2. However, factors which have been included in
the initial assessment of seriousness should not also be considered as aggravating or
mitigating factors.
